scenes.say: Sitting in an air conditioned room all day, and your eyes feel dry and burning? Here's why.

scenes.en: AC dries the air. Your tear layer dries faster, so eyes feel gritty.
scenes.ta: AC காற்றை உலர வைக்கும்; கண்ணீர் சீக்கிரம் காய்ந்துவிடும்
scenes.say: An air conditioner pulls moisture out of the air. The thin layer of tears on your eye dries faster, so your eyes feel gritty and tired.

scenes.en: We blink much less when we stare at a screen.
scenes.say: Did you know? Studies show we blink much less when we stare at a screen. Fewer blinks means even drier eyes.

scenes.en: Turn the vent away from your face. Drink enough water.
scenes.ta: AC காற்று முகத்தில் படாமல் திருப்புங்கள்; தண்ணீர் குடியுங்கள்
scenes.say: First, turn the air conditioner vent away from your face, and drink enough water through the day.

scenes.en: Every 20 minutes, look 20 feet away for 20 seconds. Blink fully.
scenes.say: Second, every twenty minutes, look at something twenty feet away for twenty seconds, and blink fully a few times.

scenes.en: Keep a bowl of water or plants nearby. Don't set the AC too cold.
scenes.say: Third, keep a bowl of water or a few plants nearby, and don't set the temperature too cold.

scenes.en: Redness, pain or blurred vision doesn't go away.
scenes.ta: சிவப்பு, வலி, மங்கல் நீடித்தால் கண் மருத்துவரை பாருங்கள்
scenes.say: If redness, pain or blurred vision does not go away, see an eye specialist. Book an eye test today.
